title: ESPN NBA insiders to preview new NBA season in Manila
summary: ESPN NBA insiders Brian Windhorst and Tim MacMahon are set to bring their expertise to Manila as they preview the 2026-27 NBA season during The Hoop Collective World Tour on October 5.
